scope.note: New-data candidate sites are represented in development data; the MNKA ranges overlap. Not individual-ID independent (230 tags cross release boundary).

contrast.method: Joint phase-specific site×taxon×plot, site×calendar-month and year fixed-effects with cluster-robust site covariance allowing old/new same-site correlation; t critical with df=site_count-1; after outcome exposure, descriptive only

interpretation.cannot_claim: No verified temporal ecological regime shift, repulsion or territoriality. Original eight-genus generality guard failed at five of eight and fixed future five-genus mode test is inestimable. Cross-phase habitat and taxonomy compositional variation not fully excluded.
interpretation.positive_scope: Temporal event-heldout evaluation reveals inability to transport the original fixed Peromyscus Δ sign with present precision; explicit common-site and common-series matching do not restore the predicted direction.
interpretation.future_needed: Stable official NEON data release, independent detection calibrations / animal tracking or suitably powered repeated event observations without post-hoc grouping
